name: geometrikks
description: GeoMetrikks is a real-time geolocation analytics tool that tails your nginx access logs, performs GeoIP lookups, and visualizes traffic on a live interactive map - no external services required. Features: - Live GeoIP map with real-time request visualization - Traffic analytics dashboard with configurable date ranges - CrowdSec integration - Searchable access log history with filtering and sorting - WebSocket-backed live log tail - Structured application logging with a live in-UI log viewer, a fail2ban/CrowdSec-friendly login log, and downloadable rotated archives - Batch import of archived logs - Requires a TimescaleDB + PostGIS database - install the companion "geometrikks-timescaledb" template from this same repository first, or point this container at your own TimescaleDB+PostGIS instance. - Also requires a free MaxMind GeoLite2 account for GeoIP data (https://www.maxmind.com/en/geolite2/signup). See the repository README for full setup steps.

paths.name: GeoIP Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for the downloaded MaxMind GeoLite2 database. The container fixes ownership of this folder to PUID:PGID on every start, so no manual chown is needed.

paths.name: App Logs
paths.description: Where GeoMetrikks writes its own logs: geometrikks.log (structured JSONL) and login.log (plain text, fail2ban/CrowdSec-friendly), plus their gzipped archives. Mounting this keeps logs across container recreation and lets host-side tools read login.log. Ownership is fixed to PUID:PGID on start.

paths.name: Nginx Logs
paths.description: Host directory containing your nginx access logs, mounted read-only. Default assumes SWAG - change to your reverse proxy's log directory (Nginx Proxy Manager, etc.). The files must be readable by PUID:PGID.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: HTTP port for the GeoMetrikks web UI.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the app runs as. The container starts as root only long enough to remap its internal user and fix ownership of the GeoIP and App Logs folders, then drops privileges. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody' - keep it so the appdata folders match the rest of your shares, and so nginx logs written by SWAG/NPM (which also default to 99:100) stay readable.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's 'users' group.

variables.name: APP_ADMIN_USER
variables.description: Web UI login username.

variables.name: APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Web UI login password. Required unless APP_AUTH_DISABLED=true.

variables.name: APP_AUTH_DISABLED
variables.description: Set true ONLY if this container sits behind an authenticating reverse proxy (Authelia, Tailscale, etc).

variables.name: APP_SESSION_SECURE
variables.description: Mark the session cookie Secure so browsers only send it over HTTPS. Set true when you reach the UI through a TLS reverse proxy; leave false if you browse to http://server-ip:8000 directly, or you will not be able to log in.

variables.name: APP_TRUSTED_PROXIES
variables.description: Reverse-proxy IPs/CIDRs allowed to supply X-Forwarded-For, e.g. 172.17.0.0/16 for Unraid's docker bridge. Single value, comma-separated, or a JSON list. Empty (default): forwarded headers are never trusted.

variables.name: MAXMINDDB_USER_ID
variables.description: MaxMind account ID, for GeoLite2 database auto-download. Free account: https://www.maxmind.com/en/geolite2/signup

variables.name: MAXMINDDB_LICENSE_KEY
variables.description: MaxMind license key, for GeoLite2 database auto-download.

variables.name: LOGPARSER_LOG_PATHS
variables.description: Nginx access log file(s) to tail, container-side path(s). Single path or a JSON list ['/var/log/nginx/access.log', '/var/log/nginx/access2.log'] for multiple files.

variables.name: LOGPARSER_HOST_NAME
variables.description: Hostname label attached to ingested log events.

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: IP address of your TimescaleDB container - typically your Unraid server's IP if you installed the companion geometrikks-timescaledb template.

variables.name: DB_PASSWORD
variables.description: Database password. Must match POSTGRES_PASSWORD in the geometrikks-timescaledb template.

variables.name: DB_PORT
variables.description: Database port.

variables.name: DB_USER
variables.description: Database user. Must match POSTGRES_USER in the geometrikks-timescaledb template.

variables.name: DB_DATABASE
variables.description: Database name. Must match POSTGRES_DB in the geometrikks-timescaledb template.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Application log verbosity (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

variables.name: DB_ECHO
variables.description: Enable SQLAlchemy query logging.

variables.name: DB_ECHO_POOL
variables.description: Enable SQLAlchemy connection pool logging.

variables.name: DB_MAX_OVERFLOW
variables.description: Max connections above pool_size.

variables.name: DB_POOL_SIZE
variables.description: Database connection pool size.

variables.name: DB_POOL_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Connection pool timeout in seconds.

variables.name: DB_POOL_RECYCLE
variables.description: Connection recycle time in seconds.

variables.name: DB_POOL_DISABLED
variables.description: Disable connection pooling.

variables.name: DB_POOL_PRE_PING
variables.description: Enable pool pre-ping to check connections before use.

variables.name: DB_DROP_ON_STARTUP
variables.description: DESTRUCTIVE - drops all tables on startup. Development only. Leave false.

variables.name: GEOIP_LOCALES
variables.description: JSON list of GeoIP locales to use.

variables.name: GEOIP_VALIDATE_DB_PATH
variables.description: Fail settings validation when the GeoIP database file is missing.

variables.name: GEOIP_VALIDATE_LOCALES
variables.description: Validate that the specified GeoIP locales are supported.

variables.name: GEOIP_REFRESH_DAYS
variables.description: Re-download the GeoLite2 database when older than this many days.

variables.name: LOG_DIR
variables.description: Directory GeoMetrikks writes its own log files to, relative to /app. Leave at 'logs' so it lands in the App Logs mount.

variables.name: LOG_MAIN_MAX_BYTES
variables.description: Rotate the main JSONL log (geometrikks.log) when it exceeds this size in bytes. Default 10 MiB.

variables.name: LOG_MAIN_BACKUP_COUNT
variables.description: Number of gzipped main-log archives to keep.

variables.name: LOG_LOGIN_MAX_BYTES
variables.description: Rotate the login log (login.log) when it exceeds this size in bytes. Default 10 MiB.

variables.name: LOG_LOGIN_BACKUP_COUNT
variables.description: Number of gzipped login-log archives to keep.

variables.name: API_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: DEPRECATED - use LOG_LEVEL instead. Still honoured as a fallback for existing deployments; leave blank on new installs.

variables.name: LOGPARSER_IGNORE_IPS
variables.description: IPs/CIDRs the parser drops entirely - no geo event, access log or debug row. Use it to keep your own WAN traffic through the reverse proxy out of the data(LAN traffic is never ingested), e.g. 88.99.77.66. Single value, comma-separated, or a JSON list. Empty (default): nothing is ignored.

variables.name: LOGPARSER_POLL_INTERVAL
variables.description: Interval in seconds to poll the log file for new entries.

variables.name: LOGPARSER_SEND_LOGS
variables.description: Send parsed logs to the database.

variables.name: LOGPARSER_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description: Max records before a forced commit.

variables.name: LOGPARSER_COMMIT_INTERVAL
variables.description: Max time interval in seconds between database commits.

variables.name: LOGPARSER_SKIP_VALIDATION
variables.description: Skip validation of log lines.

variables.name: LOGPARSER_STORE_DEBUG_LINES
variables.description: Store all raw log lines in the debug table, not just malformed ones.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_RAW_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Days to keep raw geo_events and access_logs data.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_DEBUG_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Days to keep access_log_debug data.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_HOURLY_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Days to keep hourly continuous aggregate data.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_CAGG_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MINUTES
variables.description: Minutes between continuous aggregate refreshes.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_COMPRESSION_AFTER_DAYS
variables.description: Days after which to compress hypertable chunks.

variables.name: SCHEDULER_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable scheduled background tasks.

variables.name: SCHEDULER_LOCATION_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MINUTES
variables.description: Minutes between GeoLocation.last_hit refresh jobs.

variables.name: MAP_HOME_LATITUDE
variables.description: Optional destination latitude for live request routes. Set both home coordinates to override external-IP auto-detection.

variables.name: MAP_HOME_LONGITUDE
variables.description: Optional destination longitude for live request routes.

variables.name: MAP_AUTO_DETECT_HOME
variables.description: Resolve the server's public IP at startup and geolocate it when home coordinates are unset.

variables.name: MAP_PUBLIC_IP_URL
variables.description: JSON endpoint used for public-IP discovery; response must contain an 'ip' field.

variables.name: MAP_PUBLIC_IP_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Timeout in seconds for public-IP discovery.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_LAPI_URL
variables.description: CrowdSec Local API base URL, e.g. http://crowdsec:8080. Leave blank to disable CrowdSec integration.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_BOUNCER_API_KEY
variables.description: Bouncer API key (cscli bouncers add geometrikks) - grants read access to CrowdSec decisions.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_MACHINE_ID
variables.description: Machine ID (cscli machines add) - optional, enables ban/unban from the GeoMetrikks UI.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_MACHINE_PASSWORD
variables.description: Machine password - optional, enables ban/unban from the GeoMetrikks UI.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_DEFAULT_BAN_DURATION
variables.description: Default duration for manual bans (Go duration string).

variables.name: CROWDSEC_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
variables.description: LAPI request timeout in seconds.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_VERIFY_TLS
variables.description: Verify TLS when LAPI uses https.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_STREAM_POLL_INTERVAL
variables.description: Seconds between decision-stream polls feeding live ban/unban updates.

variables.name: APP_NAME
variables.description: Application name shown in API metadata.

variables.name: APP_DESCRIPTION
variables.value: Real-time GeoIP lookups and traffic analytics API
variables.description: Application description shown in API metadata.

variables.name: APP_DEBUG
variables.description: Enable debug mode. Development only.

variables.name: APP_ENVIRONMENT
variables.description: Application environment name.
